scenario_title: Release-train cascade down the dependency chain
title: Elevated 5xx errors on cloud-api
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-08-28 01:26-01:55: cloud-api: 1 of 13 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-28 01:26 and 2026-08-28 01:55 UTC (peak error ratio 0.08 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 1 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.26 s vs baseline band up to 0.416 s.

_templates.macro: Release train {cycle} shipped FEAT-115 (Job-level audit trail) across services; the {svc} part ({version_to}) broke, and the failure surfaced in {alert_svc} through the dependency chain. The later parts of the same feature were harmless.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) flushes the EBS volume on every record instead of every FLUSH_BATCH.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from} (the other services' parts of FEAT-115 can stay); fix {file}:{line}; add a cross-service load test to the train.

rca.macro: Release train RT-26.35 shipped FEAT-115 (Job-level audit trail) across services; the storage-svc part (v4.22.0) broke, and the failure surfaced in cloud-api through the dependency chain. The later parts of the same feature were harmless.
rca.micro: storage/datanode/BlockWriter.java:70 (BlockWriter.write) flushes the EBS volume on every record instead of every FLUSH_BATCH.
rca.remediation: Roll back storage-svc v4.22.0 -> v4.21.0 (the other services' parts of FEAT-115 can stay); fix storage/datanode/BlockWriter.java:70; add a cross-service load test to the train.

action_items: Add a regression test covering BlockWriter.write (storage/datanode/BlockWriter.java).
Alert on the error signature `Unknown base file: /var/lib/nova/instances/_base/<HEX>`.
